name: hindsight
description: Long-term memory for AI agents. Recalls relevant past context before you answer and retains durable facts as you work, backed by Hindsight's retain/recall/reflect memory engine.

io.vectorize.hindsight.bankSelection: Set HINDSIGHT_BANK_ID to scope memory to a user, project, or team. It is sent as the X-Bank-Id header, so tools never need a bank_id argument.
io.vectorize.hindsight.selfHosted: Replace the host in mcp.json (https://api.hindsight.vectorize.io) with your own deployment's URL; the plugin is transport-only and stays otherwise identical.
io.vectorize.hindsight.deepIntegration: For automatic capture/injection (session hooks that recall before each prompt and retain transcripts on exit), use the Coding Agents integration at hindsight-integrations/coding-agents. This portable plugin exposes the same memory via explicit MCP tools.
io.vectorize.hindsight.codex: Codex's Agent Plugins loader removes the Authorization header and does not expand ${VAR} in headers, so this plugin cannot authenticate from Codex. Use `npx @vectorize-io/hindsight-coding-agents install codex` instead.
